name: ANSI/IEEE single-phase autotransformer symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for single-phase autotransformer, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The single-phase autotransformer form identifies a shared winding path between input and output. Following that common electrical path explains why this device differs from two electrically separate windings even when the voltage transformation purpose is similar.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Locate the common winding terminal and the load tap.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: An autotransformer does not provide the same winding separation as a two-winding transformer.
